address: Hôtel de Paris Monte-Carlo, place du Casino, Monaco, 98000, Principality of Monaco
bio: On the rooftop of the iconic Hôtel de Paris, Le Grill and its sliding roof has lost neither its mythical aura nor its breathtaking view! Chef Dominique Lory painstakingly works with first-class, bountiful local produce, adding a whole new high-flying dimension to barbecue cooking along the way. Examples include marinated gamberoni from San Remo packed with briny aromas, rack of lamb in savory or young free-range chicken steeped in Provençal aromas… The establishment upholds the venerable culinary art of soufflés with flair, illustrated by their hot raspberry and pistachio soufflé - to die for!...
